about_the_game:
Welcome to the whimsical world of Interweaver, where magic, mystery, and adorable creatures await! In this charming puzzle platformer game, players step into the shoes of the Weaver, a courageous necromancy student tasked with a final assignment that delves into the depths of darkness.

Set amidst the shadowy corridors and mysterious chambers of Sepultus Academia, players will navigate through beautifully crafted isometric landscapes filled with both wonder and trepidation. As the Weaver, you possess a unique blend of magic and determination, using your powers to unravel the secrets of the world and your academy and its sinister practices.



But while your fellow students seek to capture familiars through nefarious means, your compassionate nature drives you to protect these otherworldly creatures from harm. Armed with your abilities, you embark on a perilous journey to thwart the academy's malevolent intentions and free the familiars from their cruel fates.



Throughout your quest, you'll encounter a myriad of puzzling challenges and obstacles that will test your wit and courage. rom navigating treacherous terrain to outsmarting cunning adversaries, every twist and turn of the journey is shrouded in mystery and excitement.

Interweaver's hauntingly beautiful visuals, combined with its captivating storyline and immersive gameplay, create an unforgettable gaming experience that will send shivers down your spine. So prepare to unravel the mysteries of Sepultus Academia and embark on a journey where magic and danger intertwine in the most unexpected ways.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or Max OSX Sierra (10+)
  • Processor: Intel Core 1-7 - 1065G7 @ 1.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Embark on a hauntingly beautiful journey in Interweaver, a whimsical puzzle platformer. Play as the Weaver, a necromancy student on a quest to rescue familiars from the clutches of Sepultus Academia. Unravel mysteries and use magic to weave your way through captivating landscapes.
